Short answer: Yes — the UK moved back to GMT on Sunday 25 October 2026 while the US switches back on Sunday 1 November 2026, so there's a one-week shift. For calls in November (after Nov 1) 9:00 AM New York = 2:00 PM London; during the week of Oct 25–31 the same 9:00 AM New York would have been 1:00 PM London. ([gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/when-do-the-clocks-change?hss_channel=tw-89465662&utm_source=openai))

Two-line note to send to London attendees:
- Quick heads-up: our regular 9:00 AM New York call in November will be at 14:00 (2:00 PM) London time.  
- See you then.
